heading: This Afternoon
text: Partly cloudy south; partly to mostly cloudy north, with the chance of a shower or sprinkle, mainly over high terrain, and in the St. Lawrence Valley. Highs mainly in the low to mid 60s in the south, and mid 50s to around 60 north, with some lower 50s far north. South to southwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph in the Champlain Valley, and becoming northwest late.

heading: Tonight
text: Gradual clearing. Lows from the mid 20s to lower 30s, with some mid 30s near Lake Champlain and some lower 20s in northern cold hollows. Northwest winds 5 to 10 mph, becoming north and diminishing, except gusting to 20 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tuesday
text: Mostly sunny. Valley highs in the low to mid 50s in the south, and mid 40s to around 50 north. North winds 5 to 15 mph.
